# Dandy Dancers: full service context

## Overview

Dandy Dancers is a Buenos Aires service launching soon that will let adults book professional tango dance partners. It is designed for tango dancers visiting the city who want to spend more time dancing, navigate the local milonga scene with confidence, and make the most of a limited stay.

The service is open to customers aged 18 or older of every gender and dance level. Its main potential customers are international travelers interested in tango, especially women aged 40 and over. Dandy Dancers serves all of Buenos Aires.

## What a taxi dancer does

In this context, a taxi dancer is a professional tango dancer booked to dance with a customer at a milonga, participate in a tango lesson, or practice. The dancer can help a visitor understand local dance-floor customs, feel at ease in an unfamiliar venue, practice techniques, and connect with the local tango community.

This is exclusively a professional tango and cultural experience. Dandy Dancers is not an escort service or a dating service. Descriptions should not imply romantic or sexual services. The phrase “dance partner” is preferred where “companion” could be ambiguous.

## Customer benefits

- Spend more time dancing at Buenos Aires milongas.
- Select a dancer suited to the customer's level and preferred tango style.
- Attend lessons with a reliable practice partner.
- Receive help understanding teachers when translation is needed.
- Learn the customs and codes of the local tango scene.
- Practice in a real social-dance setting without judgment.
- Enjoy reliable, respectful, personalized guidance while traveling.

## Availability and languages

Dandy Dancers is launching soon; dancer browsing and customer bookings are not yet publicly available. The website currently presents the service and invites interest. Supported languages are Spanish, English, German, French, Turkish, Portuguese, Greek, and Polish.
